start.name: Village Square
start.description: A bustling square with cobblestone paths.

tavern.name: The Prancing Pony
tavern.description: A cozy tavern filled with warmth and laughter.

shop.name: General Store
shop.description: Shelves lined with various goods and supplies.

gate.name: Village Gate
gate.description: A heavy wooden gate marking the edge of the village.

forest.name: Dark Forest
forest.description: Tall trees block out most of the sunlight. You hear growling nearby.

clearing.name: Forest Clearing
clearing.description: A peaceful clearing with a stone altar at the center.

alley.name: Dark Alley
alley.description: A narrow alley behind the tavern. It smells of danger.

well.name: Old Well
well.description: An ancient well covered in moss. A note is pinned nearby.

merchant.name: Shop Keeper
dialogue: What can I get for you today?

elder.name: Village Elder
dialogue: Traveler, our village needs your help.
Bring me herbs from the forest and I shall reward you.
